headline: Wistron Optimistic on Second-Half Outlook, AI Orders Strong Through Next Year - Free Finance
summary: Wistron said customer demand remains strong and expects second-half AI server business to grow compared with the first half. It said first-half 2027 demand is already partly visible from customer forecasts.
why: Wistron is a Taiwanese contract manufacturer that builds servers for major technology customers. Its order outlook is a read on demand for AI infrastructure.
